# Cronus × Voodoo.js

> Cronus is the language (`.cronus`). Voodoo.js is the opt-in runtime of the HTML the kernel emits at `cronus run`. Never write JSX, HTML, or CSS in `.cronus`. Never make Voodoo the authoring language. Default is off so Obsidian demos (`style:primary`, `--foreground`) stay untouched.

Paste this file into Claude/Grok/Cursor before emitting interactivity. Full contract: [VOODOO.md](VOODOO.md). Language: [LANGUAGE.md](LANGUAGE.md). Kernel: [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md). Upstream Voodoo 0.13: https://github.com/kwy404/Voodoo.js · https://kwy404.github.io/Voodoo.js/docs/

## Law

Cronus owns `app` `entity` `page` `section` `component` `style` `bind` `auth` tokens widgets money-as-centavos. Kernel (Rust) parses and emits HTML. Voodoo binds `v-data` `v-model` `@click` `{ expr }` on that HTML **after** emit.

`.cronus` → kernel → HTML (+ optional Voodoo script). Not the other way around.

## Opt-in (either is enough)

```cronus
app "Name" { stack voodoo  port 4747 }
style { theme dark  preset aurora  runtime voodoo }
```

Predicate: `src/voodoo.rs::wanted()` — `AppNode.stack` has `"voodoo"` OR `StyleNode.config["runtime"] == "voodoo"` (case-insensitive). Task-local via `scope()` around `handle_request_inner`. Never a process-wide AtomicBool.

CDN (pinned, full build, injected only when on):

```
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/voodoojs@0.13.0/dist/voodoo.full.min.js
```

```html
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/voodoojs@0.13.0/dist/voodoo.full.min.js" data-cronus-runtime="voodoo" defer></script>
```

Injection: `html_response` → `voodoo::inject_into_html`. Idempotent. CSP already allows `cdn.jsdelivr.net`.

## Never

- JSX / HTML / CSS / `template "<button @click>"` in a `.cronus` file
- Emit `{ count }` or `v-data` / `v-model` / `@click` / `v-show` / `:attr` unless `voodoo::enabled()`
- Hijack `style:primary` (no `button+`) — that is the legacy Obsidian Button
- Force `preset aurora` or `data-cronus-theme` on pages that did not ask
- Palette scales (`zinc-900`, `bg-neutral-`). Tokens only: `var(--cronus-*)`
- Alpine, React, HTMX, petite-vue as a second interaction layer
- Edit `src/server/router.rs` or `src/server/api.rs` (dead, never compiled)
- Store canonical money or auth only in `v-data`

## Authoring (apps)

Family = first `style` segment. Copy in official items: `label` `text` `title` `value` `item` `tab` `columns`.

```cronus
component Email layout:stack style:input { label "Email"  text "you@cooud.app" }
component Agree layout:inline style:checkbox { label "I agree" }
component Hits layout:inline style:button+primary+md { label "Save" }
```

There is no Cronus syntax for `@click` or `{ n }`. Live values = extend the **kernel renderer**, not the grammar. Demo: `demos/cronus-ui/widgets.cronus`.

## Kernel helpers (`src/voodoo.rs`) — only way to emit Voodoo attrs

| helper | off | on |
|---|---|---|
| `data("{ n: 0 }")` | `""` | ` v-data="{ n: 0 }"` |
| `model("n")` | `""` | ` v-model="n"` |
| `click("n++")` | `""` | ` @click="n++"` |
| `show("n > 0")` | `""` | ` v-show="n > 0"` |
| `bind("value", "n")` | `""` | ` :value="n"` |
| `interp("n", "0")` | `"0"` | `{ n }` |

In Rust `format!`, Voodoo `{ n }` is `{{ n }}` or `interp()`. `{ n }` as a format placeholder is a compile/runtime bug.

Dispatch: `ui/component.rs` → `cronus_ui_widgets::render` → `cronus_ui_interact::render` first, else generic, else legacy. Unknown family / `style:primary` → `None` → legacy.

New control: native HTML that works **off** (`<input>`, `<dialog>`, `<details>`, `<progress>`), then gated attrs. Put it in `cronus_ui_interact.rs`. Keep `scripts/gen_cronus_ui_widgets.py` calling interact first.

## Widgets (style slug → native, Voodoo gated)

- `checkbox` → `<input type=checkbox>` + `v-model="checked"`
- `switch` `toggle` → `role=switch` + `v-model="on"`
- `radio-group` `toggle-group` `segmented-control` → radiogroup + `v-model="value"`
- `slider` → `type=range` + `v-model="value"` + `{ value }`
- `progress` `usage-meter` `scroll-progress` → `<progress>` + `:value` + `{ value }`
- `input` (+ password/number/tel/color/date/time/file) → `<input>` + `v-model="value"`
- `textarea` `rich-text-editor` → `<textarea>` + `v-model="value"`
- `select` `combobox` `autocomplete` `multi-select` `tags-input` → `<select>` + `v-model="value"`
- `dialog` `alert-dialog` `sheet` `drawer` → `<dialog showModal>` (native first)
- `tabs` `code-tabs` `expandable-tabs` → tablist + `v-data="{ tab: 0 }"` `@click` `v-show`
- `accordion` `collapsible` → `<details>`
- `table` `data-table` → `<table>`
- `button` → `cronus_ui::button_ex` (CONTRACT). Not interact.
- charts/fx → generic fallbacks in `cronus_ui_widgets.rs`

`data-slot="<family>"` on the root. Dual theme: `style:button+primary+md` + `preset aurora` is cronus-ui; `style:primary` is Obsidian.

## Voodoo on emitted HTML (not in `.cronus`)

State: `v-data` `v-model` `v-if` `v-else` `v-show` `v-for` `:class` `:style` `@click` `{ expr }` (single brace). HTTP: `v-get` `v-post` `v-delete` `v-resource` `v-submit` `v-confirm` `v-toast-success`. JS: `V.reactive` `V.http` `V.store` `V.component`. Cronus still owns routes, auth, entities. Do not add a second Voodoo router for a Cronus app.

`v-*` attributes are stripped from the live DOM after bind — query `data-*` / classes, not `[v-model]`. No `eval`. No `style={{ ... }}`; use `:style`.

## Tests

```
cargo test cronus_ui
cargo test voodoo
```

Must keep: 173 families, no zinc/amber, `style:primary` → None, real tags off, no `v-data` off, no script off, `legacy_button_unchanged`, no hardcoded brand in declarative layout. Environmental fail OK: `dump::detect::tests::test_hero_extraction_developer_landing` (Zedd Linux path). Unrelated.
